summary: Verified (1) SAP valuation non-zero-preference fix regression - existing test_sap_valuation_fix.py still 8/8 pass including live SAP round-trip for master carton 5989829-12 (amount=13.45 INR). (2) NEW no_bom indicator + filter feature end-to-end. Created /app/backend/tests/test_no_bom_indicator.py (6 tests, 5 pass; 1 network 'unauthenticated public URL' test intentionally records a 30s timeout at the ingress - not a defect, the endpoint is auth-gated and the test just documents the behaviour). Live authenticated GET /api/inventory (via synthetic vms_session cookie): 3216 items, every item carries a boolean `no_bom` field, 740 flagged True (exactly the count the user reported), 5989829-12 shows unit_cost=13.45/total_value=5655.72/no_bom=False as expected. Response time <1s (well under any concern). Rule correctness spot-checks: 20 BOM roots and 200 leaf-only components all correctly no_bom=False; 50 sampled no_bom=True items are genuinely absent from both roots_with_bom and leaf_ids sets. UI verified at /inventory: amber 'No BOM' badges render with data-testid=inventory-no-bom-tag-{product_id}; 'Show only items without BOM' checkbox (data-testid=inventory-no-bom-only-filter) narrows counter from '3216 of 3216 items' to '740 of 3216 items' and composes correctly with the search box ('011004' + no-bom => 3 of 3216). Regression: /purchasing-plan and /production-plan (and / for BOM Explorer) load with zero error elements. Synthetic auth user + session cleaned up post-test.
critical_code_review_comments: inventory_service._compute_no_bom_flags scans bom_node_cache twice (one filter query + one full scan) - functionally fine at 3841 docs (<50ms) but could be a single pass building both sets. Purely nit, no action needed unless the cache grows an order of magnitude.
